$comment: The Wonders of Africa — an Afrinkong collection, and said to be one. There is no official continental ranking and this file does not pretend there is: the standing line on the section is 'An Afrinkong collection of places worth crossing a continent to see', which is what gives the list room to grow, reorder and change its mind without anybody having been misled.
$why: The site had three ways in and they all start with the traveller or the map — what do you want to feel, where do you want to go. Nothing started with Africa. A wonder is the other direction: here is a thing that exists, and it is worth arranging your year around. Feel, then wonder, then discover, then choose.
$strands: Grouped by what makes a place extraordinary rather than by country, because grouping by country is what the atlas already does and would make this a second, worse atlas. A wonder that spans a border — Victoria Falls, the Virunga — belongs to both countries and to neither, which the strands handle and a country list cannot.
title: The Wonders of Africa
line: Some places don’t need explaining. You just need to stand there.
say: From waterfalls that disappear into the earth to deserts with no end to them, from cities carved out of rock to forests where the last of something still lives — Africa holds places that change the scale of what you thought the world was.
stamp: An Afrinkong collection of places worth crossing a continent to see
close: The continent has many ways to amaze.
$photos: A wonder carries a photograph only where this repository holds one OF THAT PLACE, which is four of the twenty-three. Everything else is drawn on its strand's ground instead. Assigning the mountain-gorilla frame to Bwindi would have been the tempting version and would have been a guess: mountain gorillas live in two forests and nothing on file says which one this is. A photograph under a place name is a claim that the photograph is of that place, and it is not worth spending the reader's trust to fill a grid.

intro.photo_alt: A camp of white canvas tents and a low striped awning pitched on open sand, with the sun just clear of the dunes on the horizon behind them

strands.name: Earth
strands.say: Mountains, deserts, waterfalls, and the geology that made them.

strands.name: Wildlife
strands.say: Migration, gorillas, elephants, predators, and species that live nowhere else.

strands.name: Civilisations
strands.say: Ancient cities, kingdoms, archaeology, and architecture built to last.

strands.name: Ocean
strands.say: Islands, reefs, and the water between them.

strands.name: Human culture
strands.say: Living traditions, food, music, craft, and the communities that keep them.

wonders.name: Victoria Falls
wonders.say: The river does not simply fall. It disappears into the earth.
wonders.photo_alt: Victoria Falls seen along the gorge with a rainbow standing in the spray thrown up by the river

wonders.name: The Serengeti
wonders.say: Where the horizon moves.

wonders.name: Kilimanjaro
wonders.say: Africa’s highest point, and you walk up it.
wonders.photo_alt: Kilimanjaro from the plain, its snow-capped summit standing clear above a bank of cloud, with an elephant walking across dry ground in the foreground

wonders.name: The Okavango Delta
wonders.say: A river that never reaches the sea.
wonders.photo_alt: Flying over the Okavango Delta Botswana

wonders.name: The Namib and Sossusvlei
wonders.say: The oldest desert on earth, and it is still moving.
wonders.photo_alt: Namib desert, home of the largest dunes in the world

wonders.name: Bwindi
wonders.say: Forest, mist, and one of the rarest encounters left.

wonders.name: The Pyramids of Giza
wonders.say: Four thousand years later, still standing where they were put.
wonders.photo_alt: The pyramids of Giza from the air, the three of them on the desert plateau with the city running up to the edge of it

wonders.name: Lalibela
wonders.say: Eleven churches, cut downward into solid rock.
wonders.photo_alt: A rock-hewn church in Lalibela, Ethiopia, showcasing its architectural brilliance.

wonders.name: The Ngorongoro Crater
wonders.say: A collapsed volcano with its own weather and its own animals.
wonders.photo_alt: Caracal hunting birds in Ngorongoro Crater, Tanzania

wonders.name: The Virunga Mountains
wonders.say: Three countries, one range, and the mountain gorillas between them.

wonders.name: The Sahara
wonders.say: Larger than the country you live in. Probably larger than several.

wonders.name: Table Mountain
wonders.say: A city built at the foot of a mountain that is flat on top.
wonders.photo_alt: A flat-topped mountain and its two flanking peaks seen across a bay at sunset from rocks in the foreground, with surf breaking and a container ship at anchor

wonders.name: The Bazaruto Archipelago
wonders.say: Dunes in the sea, and dugongs in the channel.

wonders.name: The Granite Islands
wonders.say: Boulders older than the ocean around them.

wonders.name: Madagascar
wonders.say: Eighty-eight million years alone, and it shows.
wonders.photo_alt: Beautiful alley of baobabs during sunrise in Morondava, Madagascar.

wonders.name: Gorongosa
wonders.say: A park that was emptied by a war and is filling again.

wonders.name: The Omo Valley
wonders.say: Where more languages are spoken than in most countries.

wonders.name: Great Zimbabwe
wonders.say: A city of dry stone, built without mortar, that gave a country its name.

wonders.name: Timbuktu
wonders.say: A byword for the ends of the earth, and a library long before that.

wonders.name: Djenné
wonders.say: The largest mud-brick building in the world, replastered every year by the town.

wonders.name: The Valley of the Kings
wonders.say: Sixty-odd tombs cut into a dry valley, and they are still finding them.
wonders.photo_query: Valley of the Kings Luxor Egypt
wonders.photo_alt: Tomb KV9 in Egypt's Valley of the Kings for Pharaohs Ramesses V and VI

wonders.name: Cape Coast and Elmina
wonders.say: Two castles on a shoreline, and the doors that faced the sea.

wonders.name: Robben Island
wonders.say: A prison, a quarry, and a man who came out and forgave it.
wonders.photo_alt: Cape Town as seen from Robben Island

$photo_search: What to ask a provider for, per wonder with no photograph, and the words that have to appear in the photographer's OWN description before a picture is allowed to stand under that name. photo_terms is AND across entries and OR inside one, separated by a bar. It is written here rather than derived from the name because which words prove a photograph is of Great Zimbabwe is an editorial judgement: 'zimbabwe' alone is a country of 390,000 square kilometres. A wonder with no terms is staged for a person and never bound automatically.
